paite: Huchih lai a mipi sang tampi kiphu mawimawi zou hial a ahong kikhop un, Jesu'n amasapen in anungzuite kiang ah, "Pharisaite silngou, lepchiahna lak ah pilvang un,
heading: Nungzuite Thuhilhna / (Mat 10.26-27)

paite: kilang lou ding a selguk bangmah a-om kei a; theih louh ding a iim leng bangmah a-om sam kei hi.
Huaiziak in mial a na gen peuh uh vak a zak in a-om ding; dantan sunggil a bilbul a na thugen uh intung vum ah tangkoupih in a-om ding hi.
"Huan ka lawmte aw, ka hon hilh ahi, pumpi that a, huai nung a bangmah dang hih nawn theiloute zaw, kihta kei un,
heading: Lauh Ding Pen / (Mat 10.28-31)

paite: Himahleh kua ahia na lauh ding uh ka hon hilhkhol ahi; ahihlup nung a leng Gehenna a paihtheihna thuneipa lau un.
"Dal dangka nih in kawlgit nga azuak sek kei ua hia? Himahleh alak ua khat leng Pathian in amangngilh ngei kei hi.
Na luzang ua samzangte nangawn leng sim vek ahi uh. Lau kei un; kawlgit tampi sang in na manphazaw uhi.
"Huan ka hon hilh ahi, mite ma a hon gum peuhmah Pathian angelte ma ah Mihing Tapa in agum sam ding hi.
heading: Khrist Gum Leh Gum Lou / (Mat 10.32-33; 12.32; 10.19-20)

paite: Himahleh mite ma a hon kitheihmohbawl peuhmah Pathian angelte ma ah ka kitheihmohbawl sam ding hi.
Mihing Tapa kalh a thu gen peuhmah agenkalhna ngaihdamsak ahi ding a; himahleh Kha Siangthou hilhial gensia zaw agensiatna ngaihdamsak ahi kei ding.
"Sinagog a mite, vaihawmte, heutute ma a ahon pi hun chiang un, bangchi in bang thu in ka dawng dia, bang thu ka gen dia chi in lungkham kei un.
Huai huntak in, bang ahia na gen ding uh, Kha Siangthou in ahon hilh ding hi,” achi hi.
Mipi lak a khat in Jesu kiang ah, "Sinsakpa, ka u kiang ah gou hon hawm sam ding in hilh in," achi hi.
heading: Mihau Hai Gentehna

paite: Himahleh ama'n akiang ah, "Mihing, noumau tung ah kua'n ahia kei thukhenpa hiam tan seppa hiam a hon bawl?" achi hi.
Akiang uah, "Pilvang unla, enna lak ah kiveng un; hauhna mihing damsan ahi kei," achi hi.
Huan akiang uah gentehna thu agen a, "Mihau kuahiam ahong pung mahmah hi.
Huchi in akingaihtuah a, bangchibang in ka hih diam aw? Ka buh-le-bal koihkhawmna ding ka nei kei hi.
Hichibang in ka hih ding e, 'ka buh innte ka phel ding a, asang a lianzaw in ka lam dia, huai ah buh leh ka van tengteng ka koihkhawm ding.'
Huan ka kha kiang ah, 'Kha aw, kum tampi sung daih ding tampi na kholta; khawl inla, ne in dawn inla, nuamtak in om in, ka chi ding,' achi hi.
Himahleh, Pathian in akiang ah, 'Nang mihai, tuzan chiah na kha ahon laksak ding uh, huai na lamkhiakte, kua a ahita dia?'
Amau a dia gou khol a, Pathian lam a hauloute huchi ahi uh," achi hi.
Huan anungzuite kiang ah, "Huaiziak in ka hon hilh ahi, bang ka ne diam aw? chi in na hinna thu uh leh bang silh in ka teng diam aw? chi in na pumpi thu uah lunghimoh kei un.
heading: Pathian Muanna / (Mat 6.25-34)

paite: Nek ding sang in hinna athupizawa, puansilh sang in leng pumpi athupizaw hi.
Va-akte ngaihtuah dih uh, buh atuh kei ua, a-at sam kei uh; buhpang leh buh inn leng anei kei uh; himahleh Pathian in amaute avak hi; noute vasate sang a manphazaw na hi uh.
Huan nou lak ah lunghimoh ziak a kua'n ahia ama dunglam tong khat a hihsang thei tuan?
Hiai lel leng hihtheiloute'n bangziak a thil dang lunghimoh nak na hi ua?

Lilite khandan ngaihtuah dih uh; nna asem kei ua, khau leng akhek kei uh; himahleh ka hon hilh ahi, Solomon hilhial leng athupina tengteng a akizep in, hiai lilite lak a khat tuk in zep in a-om kei hi.
Huchi in gamlak loupa tuni a hing a, azing a thukkhuk a khul nawn mai ding bawn Pathian in hichi tel a azepleh, aw nou mi gintawmte, huaite sang in puansilh hon pe zaw na tel in chia!
Huan na nek ding uh, na dawn ding uh, zong kei un; ginglel in leng om sam kei un.
Khovel a namte'n huai thil tengteng azong uh; huai bang na kiphamoh uh chih na Pa un atheigige hi.
Himahleh Pathian kumpigam zong zaw un, huchi in huai thilte leng ahon piak behlap ding hi.
"Pawltawmte aw, lau kei un; nou kiang a gam piak ding na Pa uh kipah lamtak ahi.
heading: Van Hauhsakna / (Mat 6.19-21)

paite: Na neih peuh uh zuak unla, migentheite kiang ah pia un; van ah guta naih phaklouhna ah, leikha in aneksiatlouhna ah, dangka ip lui theiloute, gou bei theiloute kibawl un.
Na gou omna peuh ua na lungtang uh leng a-om ding ziak in.
"Na kawng uh gak unla, na khawnvak uh leng desa diam in om un.
heading: Sikha Kiging Gigete

paite: Mi'n apu uh kitenna ankuangluina a kipan ahong pai chiang a, kongkhak ahon kiuhtak a, hon thei pah ding a angak nilouh bang in, om un.
Apu uh ahong pai chiang in sikha na ngak nilouh a, amuhte ahampha uh; chihtaktak in ka hon hilh ahi, ama'n akawng agak dia, amau an um ding in atusak ding a, a-nna uh asepsak ding hi.
Zan lai in hiam, thoh hun in hiam a hong a, huchibang a ahon muh, huai sikhate ahampha uhi.
"Himahleh, hiai thei un, guta ahong pai ding inn neipa'n theileh aveng dia, a-inn aphenvangsak kei ding hi.
Nou leng mansa in om un, na gintak louh dak un Mihing Tapa ahong pai ding hi,” achi hi.
Huan Peter in, "Toupa, hiai gentehna koumau kia hia na hon hilh, mi tengteng?" achi hi.
heading: Sikha Ginom Leh Ginom Lou Tehna / (Mat 24.45-51)

paite: Toupa'n, "Sumkempa ginom, piltak, apu in ahun teng a atan ding uh hawmsak ding a a-inkuanpihte tung a heutu a abawl ding kua pen ahi dia le?"
Apu hong pai chiang in sikha huchibang a hih a hon muh dingpa ahampha hi.
Diktak in ka hon hilh ahi, aneih tengteng tung a heutu ding in abawl ding hi.
Himahleh huai sikha in alungtang in, "Ka pu ahong zok kei ding e," chi in asikhanu, asikhapa, na vo taleh ne in dawn in na kham taleh;
huai sikha pu, agin louh ni, atheih louh lai in ahong ding a, tum nih ahon suah ding a, miginomloute tan bang atangsak ding hi.
Sikha apu deihlam theigige napi a na kiging tuan lou a, apu deihlam a gamta loupa'n nakpitak a vuak atuak ding hi.
Himahleh theiloupi a vuakna tham a gamtapa'n awlchik a vuak atuak ding. Tampi piak a ommi kiang ah tampi phut in a-om ding a; tampi kepsakpa kiang ah atamsem aphut ding uhi.
"Khovel a mei khesuk ding a hong pai ka hi; tu in leng kang pahleh chi na tel ing e!
heading: Jesu Kikhekna Bul / (Mat 10.34-36)

paite: Himahleh baptisma tan ding ka nei, huai ka hihtangtun mateng ka om nuam lou hi na mahmah e;
khovel a lem lengsak ding a hong pai hiam hon sa na hi uh maw? Hi dek lou hial, ka hon hilh ahi, kikhenna lengsak ding a hong pai ka hi zaw.
Tunung chiang in inkuan khat ah mi nga akidou ding uh, thum in nih, nih in thum.
Akidou ding ua, pa in atapa, atapa in apa; anu in atanu, atanu in anu; atekpi in amou, amou in atekpi," achi hi.
Huan mipi kiang ah leng, "Tumlam a mei kai na muh uleh, 'vuah azu ding na chi pah ua; huan ahong zu ngei zel hi.'
heading: Hun Chiamtehna / (Mat 16.2-3)

paite: Sim huih nung na muh chiang un, 'khua alum ding, na chi ua, ahong lum hi.'
Nou lepchiahte aw, khovel leh van omdan leng na genchian thei ngal ua, bang achia tu hun theichian siam lou na hi ua?
"Bang achia noumau in thudik kikhen lou na hi ua?
heading: Na Langpa Toh Kilem In / (Mat 5.25-26)

paite: Hon hekpa toh thukhenpa kiang na zot lai un, lampi ah kileptheihna khat zong teitei in; huchi lou in zaw thukhenpa mai ah hon kailut ding a, thukhenpa'n miman heutu ahon mansak ding a, miman heutupa'n suangkul ah ahon khum kha ding hi.
K'on hilh ahi, paihsa san khat nangawn na piak kim masiah, huai a kipan na pawt kei hial ding," achi hi.
